fields.description: Master switch. When off, every endpoint returns HTTP 503 and the pull scheduler is skipped.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Used when the inbound payload does not name a company. Leave blank to force callers to be explicit.
fields.label: Default Company

fields.description: Submit the Sales Invoice after creating it. A ZATCA QR only exists for submitted invoices — leaving invoices in Draft means no QR is returned.
fields.label: Auto Submit Invoices

fields.description: Immediate submits inside the request so the QR is in the response. Queued returns the draft immediately and submits in a background job (poll get_status for the QR).
fields.label: Submit Mode

fields.description: When an external ID maps to an existing Draft invoice, overwrite it. Submitted invoices are never modified.
fields.label: Update Existing Drafts

fields.description: Off by default and should stay off. Submitted invoices carry GL entries and, once reported to ZATCA, are legally immutable.
fields.label: Allow Modifying Submitted Invoices

fields.description: Off by default: a typo in an inbound UOM otherwise silently pollutes the UOM master.
fields.label: Create Missing UOMs

fields.description: Fallback country for addresses created from payloads that omit one. Required for the ZATCA buyer country code.
fields.label: Default Country

fields.description: Extract structured address parts (street, building number, district, city, postal code) out of a single free-text address string. ZATCA Phase 2 standard invoices reject blank buyer address parts, so enable this when the source system only sends one address line.
fields.label: Parse Free-Text Address

fields.description: One field=regex per line. The first capture group is used. Supported fields: address_line1, address_line2, custom_building_number, custom_area, city, pincode, state. Leave blank to use the built-in KSA defaults.
fields.label: Address Parse Patterns

fields.description: Auto returns Phase 2 data when ZATCA Business Settings exist for the company, otherwise falls back to Phase 1. All cryptography is performed by the ksa_compliance app — this app never signs or hashes anything itself.
fields.label: Phase Resolution
fields.options:
Auto
Phase 2 Only
Phase 1 Only
Disabled

fields.description: Render the QR payload to a PNG and include it as base64 plus a data: URI. Turn off to keep responses small when the caller renders the QR itself.
fields.label: Include QR PNG

fields.description: Include the full signed UBL XML in responses. Off by default — it adds roughly 30-60 KB per invoice.
fields.label: Include Signed XML

fields.description: Block the response until ZATCA clearance/reporting finishes, up to this many seconds (hard cap 30). Keep at 0. The QR, UUID and hash are computed locally and are already in the response; only integration_status is asynchronous. Poll get_status instead of holding an HTTP worker.
fields.label: Wait For Clearance (seconds)

fields.description: Every endpoint already requires a logged-in user via Frappe token auth (Authorization: token <api_key>:<api_secret>) and checks Sales Invoice permissions. The controls below add defence in depth.
fields.label: Transport Guards

fields.description: Additionally require a shared secret header on every request.
fields.label: Require Shared Secret Header

fields.description: One IP or CIDR block per line. Leave blank to allow any source IP.
fields.label: Allowed IPs / CIDRs

fields.description: Optional. Use this only when the external system cannot POST to ERPNext and must be polled instead. Push mode (create_invoice) is preferred because it can return the QR synchronously.
fields.label: Scheduled Pull

fields.description: Map arbitrary keys from the inbound payload onto ERPNext fields, including custom fields. This is what keeps the app client-agnostic: no client-specific fieldname is hardcoded anywhere in the code.
fields.label: Custom Field Mapping

fields.description: Store request and response bodies on the log. Disable if payloads carry data you do not want retained.
fields.label: Log Payload Bodies

fields.description: Logs older than this are deleted nightly. 0 keeps them forever.
fields.label: Log Retention (days)
